_doc: Symbol-class carriers (ml_tts_symbol.py): natural sentences with 2-4 typed number slots. Slot types: pct (percent, unit word or sign), pa/pb (the low end / the high end of a percent range: pa a bare number, pb a percent), dec (decimal + noun), cur (price), curbig (big amount with a currency symbol), mag (number + magnitude word, the template says what follows), bign (a count >= 1000, the template gives the noun), dist / speed / mass / temp / vol / area (units), phone, code (letter + digit code), year, int (a count 2-999, the template gives the noun). A trailing digit numbers a second slot of one type ({pct2}). Nouns after bign / int are masculine in es / pt / it / fr (the count readings are masculine).
